2607.22400.title: A Self-Calibrating Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Edge Resource Allocation
2607.22400.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents, transitioning from static conversational interfaces to dynamic systems capable of complex reasoning, tool execution, and decision-making. However, the operational reliability of these agentic AI systems is fundamentally challenged by the absence of reliable ground truth in open-ended environments and the risk of increasing operational drift over time. To address this challenge, we propose and experimentally evaluate an agentic AI framework, designed to enforce autonomous integrity within LLM-driven systems. We design a self-calibration mechanism that mitigates drift and dynamically approximates ground truth by incorporating an ARIMA forecaster, without requiring continuous human oversight. To demonstrate the effectiveness and reliability of our methodology, we apply it to the complex domain of profiling the resource usage of zero-knowledge workloads in edge computing networks. Experimental results show that the proposed self-calibrating agentic framework successfully profiles the zero-knowledge workloads, achieving a higher accuracy than baseline LLM agents by 91.7% for resource usage prediction and improving the prediction speed by 71.7% compared to pure profiling, establishing a robust foundation for deploying autonomous AI in decentralized infrastructures. Furthermore, the ground truth generation using the proposed ARIMA leaping algorithm is 52% faster than a standard ARIMA forecasting algorithm, while achieving the same accuracy.
2607.22400.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）越來越多地被部署為自主代理，從靜態對話介面轉變為能夠進行複雜推理、工具執行和決策的動態系統。<lb/>然而，這些代理型人工智慧系統的運行可靠性在根本上受到開放式環境中缺乏可靠真相的挑戰，以及隨著時間推移而增加的操作漂移風險。<lb/>為了解決這一挑戰，我們提出並實驗評估了一個代理型人工智慧框架，旨在強化LLM驅動系統中的自主完整性。<lb/>我們設計了一個自我校準機制，通過整合ARIMA預測器來減輕漂移並動態近似真相，而無需持續的人類監督。<lb/>為了展示我們方法的有效性和可靠性，我們將其應用於邊緣計算網絡中零知識工作負載的資源使用情況的複雜領域。<lb/>實驗結果顯示，所提出的自我校準代理框架成功地對零知識工作負載進行了剖析，在資源使用預測方面比基準LLM代理提高了91.7%的準確率，並且與純剖析相比，預測速度提高了71.7%，為在去中心化基礎設施中部署自主人工智慧建立了堅實的基礎。<lb/>此外，使用所提出的ARIMA跳躍算法生成的真相比標準ARIMA預測算法快52%，同時達到相同的準確性。
